originalTitle: The rise of AI election ads in US midterms campaign
summary: BBC Verify has tracked dozens of AI ads to assess how they are being used by campaigns in the midterms.
content:
Researchers say AI ads are being used more than ever in the US midterms campaign ahead of the elections in November.

Some of the ads are being funded by outside political groups but they have also come directly from candidates in some key races.

BBC Verify has tracked dozens of AI ads to assess how they are being used by campaigns - as Jake Horton explains.

Produced by Krystal Campos. Graphics by Sally Nicholls and Henry Esterson.
chineseTitle: AI 选举广告在美国中期选举中的兴起
chineseSummary: BBC verify 跟踪了数十个人工智能广告，以评估中期选举中的竞选活动如何使用它们。
chineseContent:
研究人员表示，在 11 月大选前的美国中期选举中，人工智能广告的使用比以往任何时候都多。

一些广告是由外部政治团体资助的，但它们也直接来自一些关键竞选的候选人。

正如杰克·霍顿 (Jake Horton) 所解释的那样，BBC verify 跟踪了数十个人工智能广告，以评估广告活动如何使用它们。

由克里斯塔尔·坎波斯制作。莎莉·尼科尔斯和亨利·埃斯特森制图。
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于全球新闻信号，适合用于观察外部环境、政策变化、地缘风险和市场情绪。
